summary: Register VK as the first Social Core provider adapter with user-OAuth community-wall text/image publishing, comment read/reply and bounded post-reach analytics, while keeping canonical scheduling/content state in Task 020 and failing closed on unqualified video/edit/delete capabilities.

impacts.evidence: The adapter receives only a validated tenant-bound connector Account. Configured GroupID and every remote publication/comment/analytics lookup are checked against that account before remote access; no caller tenant selector exists.

Comment reads project only remote IDs, bounded text and timestamps; provider profile/raw payloads are excluded. Analytics projects aggregate counters only. OAuth bytes remain callback-scoped and fixtures are synthetic.
Task 040 adds no public TORGNEXA HTTP/OpenAPI operation.
Task 040 adds no EventBus/webhook schema; canonical Task-020 publication events remain unchanged.

Connector SDK v1 gains additive SocialCommentReader/SocialCommentReplier/SocialAnalyticsReader capability-specific interfaces and bounded projections. Frozen Connector and Runtime roots remain byte-compatible and existing providers need no implementation changes.
No migration is added. Task-020 Social Core, connector accounts, mappings, sync/reconciliation and audit persistence already own durable state.

User OAuth is available only through SecretAccessor, API calls use host-injected transport, dynamic media upload URLs are HTTPS/domain/port/userinfo/fragment validated before egress, media is re-opened through Task-088 release validation, and raw provider error text is never disclosed.

The admitted writes are canonical READY publication and comment-reply operations, both explicitly declared capabilities with provider idempotency keys. Video/edit/delete remain denied; destructive post delete is not admitted without a separate approval/audit review.
Task-020 remains the publication/audit/outbox authority. The provider returns bounded remote IDs/status only and cannot mutate Core, audit, lineage or storage directly.

PublicationID is reused as wall.post.guid and comment reply idempotency key as wall.createComment.guid. Remote publication IDs are group-bound and status maps exact present/missing evidence without inventing provider scheduling state.

API egress is fixed to api.vk.com through host transport; VK-provided photo upload URLs are treated as untrusted and restricted to HTTPS vk.com/userapi.com authority. No inbound webhook capability is introduced.
HTTP and VK API-envelope auth/rate/flood/service errors normalize to bounded SDK categories; manifest pacing is conservative and live VK account ceilings remain staging evidence.
Suspend the connector account or remove the VK provider route to stop new calls. Existing canonical publication/audit evidence remains intact and no migration rollback is required.

Deterministic tests cover manifest/auth/config, text/media publish, Task-088 revalidation, upload-URL SSRF rejection, provider GUID retry identity, remote status mapping, comment cursor/reply idempotency, analytics projection, group isolation and safe VK error normalization; the provider report covers all thirteen Task-064 checks.
